_comment: Backlog for the weekly harness-build routine (.claude/skills/harness-build). Order = priority. The routine picks the first entry with status 'planned', researches the host's current hook/plugin API from official docs, builds the integration and opens a draft PR. It updates this file in that PR. Statuses: planned, in_progress, pr_open, merged, blocked. Scope agreed with the maintainer: only Cursor, GitHub Copilot and optionally Antigravity. When no entry is 'planned' or 'in_progress', the routine reports that and opens no PR.

harnesses.name: Cursor (IDE agent and cursor-agent CLI)
harnesses.notes: Partial: prompts blocked (beforeSubmitPrompt), shell commands checked before they run (beforeShellExecution: block or ask), Read-tool file reads withheld (beforeReadFile), MCP results replaced (updated_mcp_tool_output); shell output warned only; Grep, Fetch, MCP resources, lints, listings (metadata only), server-side search and attached context (rules, AGENTS.md, images) unscanned; no PII disclosure dialog. Real agent loop needs a Cursor login, so it is unverified; hook contract checked against the cursor-agent 2026.11.19 bundle (re-verified 2026-11-25).

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot (CLI and coding agent)
harnesses.notes: Full for tool and MCP results: every built-in and MCP tool result replaced (postToolUse modifiedResult), prompts replaced (userPromptTransformed modifiedTransformedPrompt), shell commands asked before they run (preToolUse ask; denied in copilot -p and autopilot); sessionStart warms the runtime. Failed-tool error text warned only; custom instructions, skills, attachments and MCP resources unscanned; cloud coding agent not covered. From 1.0.116 plugin hooks (marketplace, --plugin-dir) run only in trustedFolders and are skipped silently elsewhere; the user-level hook file from `integration copilot install` is not gated. Verified against the real copilot 1.0.103, 1.0.106, 1.0.109, 1.0.114 and 1.0.116 binaries offline with a scripted BYOK model (contract test 7/7 and e2e matrix 12/12 on 1.0.116, 2026-11-26). Interactive ask prompt not verified.

harnesses.name: Google Antigravity
harnesses.notes: Optional third host. Only build it after Cursor and Copilot are merged or blocked.
